Needs changes before merge.

The new warning is advisory. Existing blocking warnings remain in the result. The MCP finding and UI fold use separate identifiers. Both new regression tests detect their intended mutations.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:308`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the changed warning display. The body currently has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3589`: Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Record the lanes and results in the body. The body explicitly says they did not run. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, "Heavy lanes at review", requires these results before readiness. This change adds warnings to Adaptive results, so existing zero-warning assertions need verification. Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. A dry run reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. I did not run these release lanes. Not run is not a pass.

Local results:

The PR was trial-merged without conflicts with upstream main `c310c4f61`. No GitHub runner was used. The worktree had its own target directory.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` completed 373 steps: 372 passed and one failed. All four crate builds passed. Test totals:

| Crate | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| sim | 412 | 0 | 1 |
| motion | 1282 | 2 | 58 |
| app | 1817 | 0 | 27 |
| ui | 1446 | 0 | 7 |

Changed app suites passed: `adaptive_pinch` (1), `adaptive_zero_margin_island` (4), `climb_direction` (2), `shoulder_adaptive` (7), and `strategy_fallback` (1). The motion library passed 491 tests. The UI library passed 1379 tests from `crates/ui`, including the warning-fold regression. All selected UI integration suites passed.

The failed step was `motion suites: vertical_arc_entry`:

```text
an_x_aligned_first_cut_enters_on_one_g18_arc_per_level
crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:176
recorded path vertical_arc_x.cl is stale
recorded moves=22; generated moves=20

an_oblique_first_cut_stays_chords_and_says_so_once
crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:214
each level still descends on a chord fan
```

I replaced the four changed motion files with their current upstream versions in this worktree. I ran `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` again. Both failures reproduced, with the same CL mismatch. I then restored all four files. These are baseline failures, not additional findings against this PR. The quick gate remains red.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

- Remove the warning insertion from generate: the app pin failed at `strategy_fallback.rs:46`, with zero warnings instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.
- Make `rings_fallbacks` match no notes: the motion pin failed at `hsm_fallback_tests.rs:82`, with zero instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.

All mutation edits were restored. No contributor code or golden was changed. No golden file moves in this PR. The two note-format changes preserve their text.

Extra suites run:

- Neither extra-suite trigger applies. The PR changes no fixture directory, testdata file, or importer code.
- Baseline diagnostic: `camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` (one passed, two failed).
- The two mutation pins were each run with the mutation and after restoration.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Second read (read-only, not built) of head 19a736d203de3ff590de1caea27a74e951966b6c.

Verdict: no defect found by reading that can change a move or the post decision. I found one gap in the warning coverage (advisory only, low severity). It does not block the merge. I recommend a `P7` follow-up for it.

At the time of this comment, the PR is open, the head is 19a736d20, and the label is `merge-ready`.

## 1. The toolpath does not change

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs:70-71`: the two `format!` calls now use `{RINGS_FALLBACK}`. The constant at line 79 is `" - Offset rings cut "`. This is the same text as the old literal, so the note bytes are the same. The fallback condition (lines 54-61) and the strategy choice do not change.
- `pocket_hsm.rs:77-87`: the new `RINGS_FALLBACK` and `rings_fallbacks` only read notes. They change no move.
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/hsm.rs:252`: `rings_tag` gives the same string as before. The check at line 198 (`ends_with(&rings_tag(..))`) thus has the same result. The level ladder and `rings_named` do not change.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs:194`: a re-export only.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3728-3734`: this code reads `path.notes` and `path.moves` and pushes to `warns`. It does not write `path`.
- No golden file changes in the diff.

## 2. The warning

- The planner writes the note. The app counts the notes (`rings_fallbacks`) and pushes `Warning::StrategyFallback { at, areas }` (`generate.rs:3730-3733`).
- Each fallback note goes through `RINGS_FALLBACK`: the 2D door (`pocket_hsm.rs:70-71`) and the 3D ladder (`hsm.rs:199`, `hsm.rs:259` through `rings_tag`). Both end with ` instead`, so each one is counted.
- When there is no fallback, no counted note exists, so no warning is raised. `REST_RINGS` and `SHELL_RINGS` (`hsm.rs:41-55`) and the trochoid note (`pocket_hsm.rs:66`) do not contain the tail. The decision file records that these are not fallbacks.
- `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:413-414`: `blocks_post` uses a `!matches!` list of advisory kinds. The new variant is in that list. No older kind left the list, so each older blocking kind still blocks. The post gates read `blocks_post` (`posting.rs:1300`, `posting_sim.rs:176`, `posting_wire.rs:137`, `script/api.rs:283`, `kept_rejudge.rs:125`). The `out.warnings.is_empty()` checks in `posting*.rs` and `post/engine.rs:596` read the post engine strings, not verify warnings. Thus the new warning does not hold a legal program.
- The user sees it: MCP `finding()` (`mcp/job.rs:278`, `blocks_post: false`), the warning count (`mcp/job.rs:89`, `browser_tree.rs:321`, `gen_worker.rs:247`), and the UI fold on key 225.
- The text is plain English (`types.rs:547-551`). `at` comes from `position(..).unwrap_or(0)`. This is not a panic.

Gap (advisory, low severity): `generate.rs` calls `rings_fallbacks` only in the `None` (untilted) arm of `match &frame` (line 3366). The tilted arm (`Some(f) =>`, line 3777 to 3925) does not call it. Scenario: if an Adaptive op runs in a 3+2 setup and the planner falls back, the notes name the fallback, but the op shows no `StrategyFallback` warning. The output is still verified and safe. Only the report is incomplete. I did not confirm by a run that an Adaptive op can reach the tilted arm.

## 3. Exhaustive matches

- `crates/app/src/warned_moves.rs:23-45`: the match has no wildcard arm. The new kind joins `RestUnjudged` with `[None, None]`.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:268` (`key`) and `:314` (`last_move`): no wildcard arm. `UndercutLift` keeps key 222, `DrillUndersize` keeps 223, the new kind uses 225. These keys are clear of the `AvoidHit` range (216-220) and of 221.
- `mcp/job.rs:265-279`: no wildcard arm.

## 4. The test changes
